_comment: Car contact (card 06). carFriction / carRestitution: car against car, used as is (rub = survivable, punt = spin; check with npm run contact-probe). bodyFriction / bodyRestitution: the car body against walls, mixed with the wall's own values from physics.json (friction: geometric mean, restitution: the larger), kept at what walls were tuned with. Yaw inertia is physics car.inertiaScale. Car contact never invalidates a lap; only barriers and track limits do.
